### Cellular Aging Support  
Research in animal models suggests fisetin may help extend both lifespan and healthspan. In one notable study, older mice given fisetin lived longer and showed improved health markers compared to untreated mice\[4].  
- Human longevity studies are currently underway
- Cellular mechanisms observed in animals are being studied for potential human relevance
